notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Bloodsoaked Champion's power.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.
